tweet.text:
Airdrop is Dead. 💯

We’ve made the difficult decision to pause our blockchain development indefinitely.

A major factor behind this decision has been the lack of meaningful community participation and the overwhelming presence of bad actors within the airdrop campaign.

We recorded over 2 million requests across our faucets and testnet within a very short period. The resulting surge in backend infrastructure usage created thousands of dollars in unexpected infrastructure costs, largely driven by repeated and low-value actions from participants.

At this point, the cost of sustaining these activities is no longer justifiable, especially when genuine community contribution has been far below expectations.

This isn’t the outcome we wanted, but we believe transparency is important.

Thank you to everyone who genuinely supported, contributed, tested, and believed in what we were building. ❤️

We appreciate your understanding.

AI Overviews are shrinking organic CTR
The chart behind this claim comes from Seer Interactive’s Nov 2025 analysis of 3,119 queries across 42 organizations and 25.1 million impressions. For queries with AI Overviews, organic CTR fell from 1.76% to 0.61% – a 61% drop.
That does not mean search volume disappears. It means Google is answering more queries before the click, so top rankings can lose traffic even when they still exist.
My read: the useful debate is not SEO vs AEO as labels. It is whether the engine you optimize for still delivers a click.
Data source:
Seer Interactive
Related read:
Are we optimising for the right engine? Insights from the latest SEO / AEO research

Paradigm's Matt Huang says Zcash’s inflation-funded developer fund is important for sustaining public goods and strengthening the network amid rising AI and quantum threats.
Source:
https://x.com/matthuang/status/2100276142225973560

tweet.text:
A few thoughts on ZCash (disclosure: Paradigm is an investor in ZEC and ZODL):

- All blockchain ecosystems struggle with long-term funding, especially of public goods, and an inflation-funded developer fund is an elegant mechanism to do so. How this fund is allocated is a fair debate, and we should strive to improve it. But, we believe the dev fund is important, particularly in this age of AI cyber capabilities, rate of quantum progress, etc.

- As ZCash grows in acceptance and adoption as a private complement to Bitcoin, we think pure coinvoting governance introduces unpredictability that could limit long-term trust as a monetary asset, and it is better for the project to combine coinvoting with other forms of governance.

Symbiosis DeFi bridge exploited, hacker mints 46 billion fake syBTC –
Link
A hacker exploited two bugs in the Symbiosis cross-chain bridge and turned 25 cents of BTC into more than 2,000x Bitcoin's total supply in unbacked syBTC. Symbiosis puts preliminary losses at around 9.97 BTC, roughly $750K at current prices.
Smart-contract risk in cross-chain bridges isn't going away, and this kind of exploit doesn't help confidence in wrapped assets.
